content:
Talia Benson: Heads up: this is the final pre-launch checklist + who’s on point for “template launch week” support. Please reply with :thumbsup: once you’re good w/ your lane + add gaps.

Launch week = Mon–Fri (Feb 17–21). Goal: keep #docs + #support from getting paged for basics, and make fixes fast + safe.

Pre-launch checklist (must be DONE by EOD Fri):
1) Repos + tags
- [ ] redwood-quickstarts tag `v1.0.0` created + release notes drafted (Connor)
- [ ] SDK minimum versions pinned in READMEs (Monica/Dana)
- [ ] “known issues” section has current items + workarounds (Sabrina)

2) Docs-site
- [ ] landing pages live + nav wired (Elliot/Wei)
- [ ] code snippets pulled from repo are green in CI (Wei/Sahana)
- [ ] “Production checklist” section includes timeouts/retries + PII note (Elliot)

3) Telemetry + Console
- [ ] OTel traces show request_id + tenant_id + model + route + error_class (Logan)
- [ ] default dashboards/alerts pack import instructions verified (Dylan)
- [ ] smoke test emits metrics + logs w/ correlation IDs (Sahana)

4) Security
- [ ] secrets guidance + .env patterns correct + secret scanning enabled (Naomi)
- [ ] tool calling allow-list defaults + tool timeouts are documented (Naomi/Sabrina)

5) Support readiness
- [ ] 429 / streaming disconnect macro answers drafted (Dev)
- [ ] escalation path + runbook link ready (Talia)

On-call / ownership (launch week):
- “Launch Captain” (triage + coordination): Talia
- SDK issues (retry/timeout/streaming): Monica (primary), Dana (secondary)
- Template code issues (RAG/agents/combined): Sabrina (primary), Renee (secondary)
- Docs drift / snippet extraction: Wei (primary), Elliot (secondary)
- CI + smoke tests + release tagging: Sahana (primary), Connor (secondary)
- Telemetry contract / ingestion / dashboards: Logan (primary), Dylan (secondary)
- Security concerns: Naomi (primary)
- SRE consult (no paging unless severe): Sean / Rafael
- Support intake + pattern detection: Dev

Escalation rules (please sanity check):
- P0: secrets leakage / auth bypass / unsafe tool execution pattern in template => Naomi + Talia immediately, pull docs if needed
- P1: templates don’t run from fresh clone w/ hosted API key OR smoke tests failing => Sabrina/Sahana + Talia
- P2: confusing behavior (429 loops, timeouts, streaming disconnect behind proxy) => Monica/Dana + Dev, patch release if >3 reports
- P3: docs copy / minor typos => Wei/Elliot

Working channels:
- #devex (coordination)
- #support (incoming)
- #docs (docs push)
- #eng-platform (telemetry)

Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/DX/Quickstart+Templates+Launch+Week+Runbook (comment if missing anything)

Alex Martinez: :thumbsup: This looks right. One ask: make sure we have a “roll back” plan if we need to yank a template link from docs quickly. Who pushes the docs toggle?

Wei Chen: I can own the “docs toggle” / redirect if we need to pull a template page. We can swap landing CTA to “coming soon” + pin banner. I’ll add that to runbook.

Elliot Price: +1. Also, can we add a short blurb in runbook re: what we *won’t* do (e.g., won’t debug customer infra)? Keeps scope sane.

Talia Benson: Yep, adding “support boundaries” section.

Monica Patel: :thumbsup: SDK lane ok. One detail: for launch week, we should standardize what we tell folks about 429s.
Proposed wording:
- backoff with jitter
- respect `Retry-After` when present
- don’t retry streaming chunks indefinitely
I can write a short canonical snippet for Python + TS and link it.

Dana Lo: :thumbsup: I’ll pair w/ Monica on TS snippet + make sure template uses the helper everywhere. Also: can we log `error_class=rate_limited` consistently? Right now I saw `rate_limit` in one place.

Logan Wright: Good catch — contract says `error_class=rate_limited`. I’ll verify validators + update any offenders before EOW.

Sabrina James: :thumbsup: Template lane ok. Checklist item I want to add: “fresh clone” test behind corp proxy (streaming). We saw that bite dogfood.

Sean Gallagher: +1 on proxy test. Also please make sure default timeouts aren’t “infinite” anywhere.
My vote for defaults:
- connect timeout 5s
- read timeout 60s non-stream
- streaming idle timeout 90s
Anything longer should be explicit env var.

Monica Patel: That matches what we shipped in the helper. I’ll double-check templates didn’t override.

Sahana Iyer: :thumbsup: CI lane ok. Smoke tests are green on staging as of today, but there was flake on embeddings endpoint once.
I’ll add one retry at the test harness level (NOT changing product behavior) and an alert if flakes >2/day.

Connor O'Brien: :thumbsup: I can handle tagging + changelog. Please confirm final version string today so I don’t retag.

Talia Benson: Version is `v1.0.0` unless we find a blocker.

Dev Patel: :thumbsup: Support macros drafted. Top Q’s from early folks are:
1) “why do I get 401?” (wrong env var name / whitespace)
2) “429 means your service is down?”
3) “streaming stops mid-way” (proxy / timeout)
I’ll post drafts in #support for review.

Naomi Feldman: :thumbsup: Security lane ok. Please ensure:
- no tokens printed to logs (even in debug)
- READMEs explicitly say “don’t paste prod secrets into .env committed to git”
- tool allow-list is default deny + examples show validation
If any report of prompt injection leading to tool misuse, we treat as P0.

Renee Sullivan: :thumbsup: Secondary for template code. I can also monitor community posts + route here.

Dylan Brooks: :thumbsup: I’ll verify dashboards pack import on a clean account + that Console deep links from README work.

Rafael Mendes: I’m around as SRE backstop. Please add a note in runbook: if error rates spike, we check Console dashboards first (don’t guess). Also: no paging on single customer misconfig.

Talia Benson: Great. Action items I captured:
- Wei: add docs toggle/rollback steps + “support boundaries” to runbook
- Monica + Dana: publish canonical 429 + streaming guidance snippets + ensure template consistency
- Logan: enforce `error_class=rate_limited` + audit template telemetry
- Sabrina: add proxy streaming sanity check to pre-launch
- Dylan: re-verify dashboards import + deep links

If anyone sees a missing owner for “release comms / announcement copy” say now; otherwise I’m assuming Alex/Elliot already have it.

Alex Martinez: Comms is covered. Let’s ship. (reaction: :thumbsup: x6)
